summary_zh: 如果單純看噴泉，保留至少 30 分鐘，經驗上是「三大發，一小發」，每 10 分鐘噴發一次。這裡有旅客中心，有餐廳、紀念品店，廁所免費，停車場要付費，旅客中心前有加油站。
summary_en: It’s best to visit around midday so you can rest, have a meal, and use the restroom. When you reach the geyser, you’ll see both large and small eruptions; typically there are three large eruptions and one small eruption every ten minutes, so plan to stay by the geyser for at least 30 minutes. A spacious souvenir shop is also available where you can buy many gifts.
